description: Decodes a run-length packed stream into bitplane columns, writing repeated or literal bytes at a register-supplied stride. A table of offsets selects how far the destination pointer moves for each code.

name: init_table_and_enable_dma
description: Initialises a 16-bit table by subtracting a set of weights from each entry, then writes the DMA control register with the channel-enable bit set. It then retries a sequence of unnamed routines until a status check succeeds and finishes by calling a fixed series of routines.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:10A8C

description: Repeatedly calls an unnamed routine and tests a status word, returning minus one when a mismatched status is nonzero. It loops until the called routine returns zero, then makes a fixed sequence of calls and returns zero.

description: Calls an unnamed routine that returns a status, resets a mode variable to zero when it equals two, and loops until the status is zero. On a mismatched nonzero status it returns minus one, and otherwise makes a fixed sequence of calls before returning zero.

description: Copies word fields inside a structure and into a global, then walks a memory region in four-byte steps, forwards and then backwards. description: Calls an unnamed routine and, if its result is zero and a register matches a global value, copies two bytes from a record into a global, subtracting four from each. It calls one more routine when a field in another structure is negative.

name: claim_free_slot_entry
description: Scans a global table of 52-byte entries for the first slot whose marker byte is zero and claims it. It fills the slot's fields from the input registers and from a lookup table indexed by a second register, then calls an unnamed routine with the slot address.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:10D6A

description: Copies a 57-byte block and then a 59-byte block from fixed source addresses into the global state area. When the mode is not six and a flag equals four, it also copies two words into alternate globals, then clears a counter and copies a word from another global.

name: reset_globals_and_init_state
description: Zeroes the global variable area up to a fixed end address, then on first run sets a state flag and stores initial byte values. It also sets a few global words, choosing between two values according to a byte, and clears a counter.

description: Calls two unnamed routines, then stores a global value made from the low word of an input register taken modulo five, multiplied by 727, plus a second register value.

name: or_accumulate_word_blocks
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then runs a loop whose count is a global counter divided by five. Each pass ORs eight 32-bit words from a source table into two destination tables and advances the source by 250 bytes.

description: Polls the sum of two global words for a short bounded period and resets a counter. It updates a timer that calls an unnamed routine when it expires, increments a second timer, then copies two global words into two others before calling another routine.

name: clamp_two_globals_to_range
description: Clamps two global values to a range from zero up to 56: negative values become zero and values above 55 become 56.

description: Copies a link value from a record into a table slot and clears the record's back-reference. It then stores the record's offset from a base address into a second table slot, links the record there, increments a byte counter by eight and returns one.

description: Clears the link field in a record, then pushes the record onto the front of the list chosen by its key bytes. The previous head is linked back to the record and the record's offset becomes the new head.

description: Finds the list selected by a record's key bytes and unlinks the record from it, updating the head if the record is first or patching the previous link otherwise. It clears the record's link field and returns the original D0 value.

description: Writes a constant 16-bit field into the structure and calls an unnamed routine. It then writes a constant byte and three flag bytes through a pointer returned by that routine and calls another routine.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:12F20
name: set_state_on_mask_bit
description: When a mask bit is set and the structure's state byte is not the reserved value, it sets a 16-bit field from a constant or from a global table according to a flag byte. It then calls an unnamed routine and writes a constant state byte.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:12F52
name: set_flag_and_call
description: Writes a 16-bit constant into the structure, calls an unnamed routine, then writes a constant byte through the returned pointer.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:12F8A
name: mark_matching_list_entry
description: Checks a flag word and, when allowed, searches a linked list in a global table for an entry with a matching kind byte and key byte. It sets bit four of the entry's flags when found; otherwise it calls an unnamed routine unless a flag bit blocks it, and returns one or zero accordingly.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:12FE2
name: mark_matching_chain_entry
description: Walks a chain of linked entries starting from a record and sets bit four of the first entry whose kind byte and key byte both match. If none matches it calls an unnamed routine unless a flag bit blocks it, and returns one or zero accordingly.

name: call_one_unnamed_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The listing shows a 10-instruction routine that calls one other routine and is entered through a handler pointer; its exact behaviour is not recovered.

name: call_single_unnamed_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The listing shows a 7-instruction routine that calls one other routine; its exact behaviour is not recovered.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:130E4
name: expire_timer_and_set_state
description: Subtracts a 32-bit amount from a timer field in one structure. When the timer reaches zero or below, it calls an unnamed routine, sets a 16-bit field to a constant and sets a state byte depending on a flag bit, then returns one; otherwise it returns zero.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:13118
name: set_state_byte_return_one
description: Stores a constant state byte in the structure and returns one. It makes no other changes.

name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero with no other effect. It has no calls, memory writes or hardware access.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:13126
name: compute_byte_deltas_and_quotient
description: Compares two input bytes with reference bytes in the structure and writes two 16-bit difference values into two fields. It also stores a quotient computed from the larger difference divided by a structure byte, or 256 divided by that byte when the first comparison fails.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:13190
name: store_divide_quotient_word
description: Divides a 32-bit input value by a 16-bit divisor and stores the 16-bit quotient in a structure field.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:13196
name: normalize_two_byte_fields
description: Compares two input bytes with the high bytes of two input words and writes two 16-bit results into the structure. It also stores 256 divided by the divisor in a third field.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:131CC
name: claim_free_slot_and_dispatch
description: Scans a global table of 52-byte entries for a free slot and initialises it with fixed state values, the two input bytes and an index. It then calls the routine selected from a dispatch table by that index and returns its result, or zero when no slot is free.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:131EA
name: init_slot_and_dispatch
description: Initialises a given entry with fixed state values, the two input bytes and an index. It then calls the routine selected from a dispatch table by that index.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1334E
name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use; it performs no work.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:13352
name: validate_and_update_byte
description: Reads a byte from the structure and, when it is nonzero and a computed table index matches a global, calls an unnamed routine. It then copies the byte into a second structure's field when the input value is nonnegative and the byte has changed.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:133C2
name: forward_routine_result_word
description: The recovered code calls one unnamed routine and returns its 16-bit result unchanged. The listing also reports further calls that are not present in the recovered code, so the full behaviour is not recovered.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:13488
name: store_masked_keyed_bytes
description: Walks a table of 16-bit keys until a sentinel value of minus ninety-nine is reached. For each key it adds an input offset and, when the sum has no bits set in the masked positions, stores the paired byte into a global table at that index.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:134C0
name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use; it performs no work.

name: scan_masked_keys_into_list
description: Walks a table of 16-bit keys until a counter reaches zero. For each key it looks up a mask in a global table and tests it against a flag word; when bits match it walks a chain of linked entries, calls an unnamed routine on the first matching one, and records qualifying keys in a short list.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:13552
name: check_keys_against_mask_table
description: Walks a table of 16-bit keys until a sentinel value of minus ninety-nine. It returns zero if any key has invalid bits, fails its mask test, or reaches a flagged linked entry, and returns one when every key passes.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1359E
name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero with no other effect.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:135A2
name: mark_matching_keyed_bytes
description: Walks a table of 16-bit keys and, for each key with no invalid bits whose target byte equals a given value, sets that byte to fifteen. It returns the invalid-bit mask of the last key read.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:135CA
name: fill_keyed_bytes_from_table
description: Walks a table of 16-bit keys until a sentinel value of minus ninety-nine. For each key it clears a byte in a global table, and writes an input byte there when the existing byte matches a character chosen by a structure flag and a table bit is clear.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1383C
name: iterate_linked_structures
description: Walks a list of 314-byte records, decrementing a countdown for records of one type and reloading it from a second field when it reaches zero. Records of another type cause unnamed routines to be called, and each record advances a parallel 10-byte table entry.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:138C0
name: process_linked_structure_node
description: Checks a structure's timer and link fields. When a link is set it writes two bytes from the link target into an output record and returns one; otherwise it clears two link fields when a comparison fails, or writes a constant and two bytes to the output when a flag field is nonzero, returning zero when neither applies.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1395A
name: update_linked_structure_neighbor
description: Decrements a countdown in a structure and, when it expires, reloads it and searches neighbouring table entries for one with the same kind byte, comparing a weight derived from flag bits. When a neighbour's weight is higher or lower it writes a state byte and a position byte to an output record and returns one; otherwise it returns zero.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:13A82
name: find_matching_weight_neighbor
description: Checks a timer field and a stored key in a structure, then searches neighbouring table entries for one whose weight matches the structure's own weight. On a match it writes a state byte and a position byte to the output record and updates a counter, returning one; otherwise it clears a counter and returns zero.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:13B6C
name: find_matching_weight_entry
description: Walks a list of key values and, for each key whose weight matches a given weight, writes a state byte and a position byte to an output record and decrements a counter. It returns one when the counter expires and zero when no key matches or the list ends.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:13B70
name: write_entry_and_count_down
description: Writes a byte and two derived bytes into an output record and copies a 16-bit field into a second field. It then decrements a countdown and reloads it when it expires, returning one when it expires and otherwise a derived byte value.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:13B9C
name: clear_counter_return_zero
description: Clears a 16-bit counter in the structure and returns zero.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:13BA4
name: decrement_flag_and_test_counter
description: If a flag field is set, decrements a countdown and reloads it when it expires. It then compares a global value, offset by a type field, against a value from a linked entry, and when the comparison succeeds writes two bytes from that entry to the output and returns one.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:13C1C
name: dispatch_handler_by_index
description: When a global counter exceeds 249 and a flag is set, selects a handler from a dispatch table, either from a stored index or from a value returned by another routine taken modulo a size field. It calls the selected handler and returns its result, or zero when no handler applies.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:13D5C
name: find_closest_flagged_key
description: Scans a table of 16-bit keys whose table flags include bit eight, choosing the key closest to a target value derived from the structure. It returns one when a candidate is found and zero otherwise.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:13DB8
name: find_closest_flagged_key_b
description: Scans a table of 16-bit keys whose table flags include bit eight, keeping the key closest to a target value derived from the input. It returns one when a candidate is found and zero otherwise.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:13DBE
name: find_closest_flagged_key_c
description: Scans a table of 16-bit keys whose table flags include bit eight, keeping the key closest to a target value derived from the input. It returns one when a candidate is found and zero otherwise.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:13DDA
name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero with no other effect.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:13DDE
name: compare_bytes_with_retry_counter
description: Compares byte pairs from a structure and a referenced entry. When they differ it writes a status byte and two bytes to an output record and returns one; otherwise it decrements a retry counter, writes a fixed status when it expires, and in some paths calls another routine and clears a flag word.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:13F9E
name: clear_flag_when_below_quarter
description: If a 16-bit flag word is nonzero and a counter field is at most a quarter of that value, clears the flag word to zero.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:13FB6
name: store_offset_in_table
description: Stores the structure's offset into a table entry selected by a byte in the structure, then sets bit one of the structure's flag byte and returns the input value unchanged.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:13FE4
name: clamp_and_store_two_bytes
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then clamps two byte values to the range zero to 63 and writes them into a structure, each followed by a constant byte. It then calls another routine and returns the register values unchanged.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:14048
name: initialize_table_entry_from_index
description: Computes a table offset from an index byte and stores a pointer to a 14-byte record in a table entry. It then writes two input bytes, two constant bytes, a state byte and a word taken from a second table indexed by the same value, and calls an unnamed routine.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:140AE
name: clear_flag_and_zero_entry
description: If bit zero of the structure's flag byte is set, clears that bit, writes zero to a table entry selected by a byte in the structure, and calls an unnamed routine. It returns the input value unchanged.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:140F0
name: claim_table_slot_if_free
description: Calls an unnamed routine and, when it returns zero, copies two bytes from a reference structure. It claims a table slot for this structure if the slot is empty, setting a flag bit, then either calls another routine or writes fixed state values. When the call returns nonzero it writes two state bytes instead.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1417E
name: set_state_fixed_with_global
description: Writes a constant 16-bit field and a state byte into the structure, and copies a 16-bit value from a global into another field of the structure.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:14194
name: set_two_state_bytes
description: Sets two state bytes in the structure to constants and makes no other changes.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:141A2
name: check_linked_entries_for_cost
description: Computes a key from two input values and tests the masks of the table entry it addresses. It walks the linked entry chain, rejecting blocking entries and, for entries of one kind, comparing a computed value against the structure's limit. When the check passes it marks the entry and sets state values, returning zero, minus one for a mask refusal, minus two for a blocked or over-limit entry, and one for an out-of-range key.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:141BC
name: check_linked_entries_for_limit
description: Walks the linked entry chain for a key derived from an input value. It returns minus two when a blocking entry or a value over the structure's limit is found, minus one when the masked flags forbid the key, and zero otherwise, marking matching entries as it goes.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:141E8
name: check_linked_entries_for_mask
description: Walks a linked entry chain starting from an input key. It returns minus two when a blocking entry or a value over the structure's limit is found and minus one when the mask forbids the key; otherwise it returns zero.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:14204
name: walk_chain_checking_limit
description: Walks a linked entry chain from an input key and returns zero at the end of the chain. It returns minus two when it meets a blocking entry or a value over the structure's limit; otherwise it marks matching entries and sets state values as it goes.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:14296
name: walk_chain_until_limit
description: Repeatedly walks a linked entry chain from a structure's table slot, returning zero when the chain ends and minus two when a blocking entry or a computed limit is reached. Matching entries are marked and their state updated along the way.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:142CC
name: stub_return_minus_two
description: Returns minus two with no other effect.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:142D4
name: attach_slot_and_dispatch
description: If the table slot for an input index is set, calls an unnamed routine to obtain a value. It then sets a flag bit and state values in the structure, stores the value in a field, and calls the routine selected from a dispatch table by that value, returning its result.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:142F4
name: attach_value_and_dispatch
description: Calls an unnamed routine to obtain a value, sets a flag bit and state values in the structure, and stores the value in a field. It then calls the routine selected from a dispatch table by that value.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:142FE
name: attach_value_and_dispatch
description: Calls an unnamed routine to obtain a value, sets a flag bit and state values in the structure, and stores the value in a field. It then calls the routine selected from a dispatch table by that value.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:14414
name: link_nearest_unlinked_entry
description: Scans the table for the nearest entry by summed absolute byte differences that is active, not already linked and not flagged. It links that entry to the input structure, sets a state byte, and returns one when a link was made and zero otherwise.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1449A

name: initialize_entity_record
description: Writes position bytes, a kind byte, a state value and a word from a global into an entry, then calls an unnamed routine. When a 16-bit input is zero it increments a counter and stores a derived byte through a second pointer.

name: check_neighbour_cell_count
description: Checks a table cell at a position. If its low nibble is not fifteen, it reads a neighbouring cell's count: zero clears the first cell's byte and returns minus one, and other counts apart from one call an unnamed routine. A cell with low nibble fifteen is set from a value in the structure.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1670C
name: combine_high_word_with_flag
description: Unless a flag word equals one, calls an unnamed routine and uses its 16-bit result as the high word. Returns a 32-bit value formed from that high word and the flag word in the low word.

name: stub_return_minus_one
description: Returns minus one with no other effect.

name: store_byte_and_decrement
description: Copies a byte from a field of the input structure into a byte of another structure, subtracts a constant from it and returns zero.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16744
name: replace_entry_with_indirect_value
description: Looks up the table entry addressed by two input bytes. When that entry's flag byte has bit six set, it replaces the entry with the value stored at the index given by the entry itself, and otherwise does nothing.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1677A
name: update_mask_entries_for_position
description: Checks a flag word at a position and, when bit ten is clear and a mask test passes, either finds the cell value in a small table or builds a bitmask from neighbouring cells with flag bit six set. It then updates a linked entry's state, sets bits in neighbouring cells and returns one.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:167BC
name: update_mask_entries_for_cell
description: Builds a cell value from a small table or from neighbouring cells with flag bit six, then writes it to the cell. It updates a linked entry's state, sets bits in neighbouring cells, and returns one.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:167DA
name: update_neighbour_mask_bits
description: Writes a value into a cell, updates a linked entry's state, and sets bits in neighbouring cells that have flag bit six. Returns one.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:167E2
name: build_neighbour_mask_bits
description: Builds a bitmask from neighbouring cells flagged with bit six, writes the resulting value into a cell, updates a linked entry's state and sets bits in neighbouring cells. Returns one.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16870
name: update_entry_neighbour_bits
description: Finds the first linked entry of a list and sets its state values, then sets bits in neighbouring cells using the flag and table lookup. Returns one.

name: stub_return_one
description: Returns one with no other effect.

name: mark_table_cells_by_flags
description: Loops a number of times derived from a global value. Each pass calls an unnamed routine and uses its result to address a cell in a 90-entry table; when the cell is empty and its flag bits match, it writes a constant marker. It returns the last combined value.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:169CC
name: mark_table_cells_with_mask
description: Loops over a count derived from a global value, each time calling an unnamed routine to address a cell in a 90-entry table. When the cell is empty and its flag bits match a mask, it writes a constant marker there and returns the last combined value.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16A62
name: mark_table_cells_by_offset
description: Loops over a count derived from a global value and an input offset, calling an unnamed routine each time to address a cell in a 90-entry table. Where a cell's kind bits equal fifteen it writes a constant marker, and it returns the last combined value.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16AF4
name: spawn_entries_matching_mask_cells
description: Scans a list of offsets for cells whose flag bits match a mask. For each match it claims a free 16-byte entry, writing its position, a kind byte and two values from tables scaled by a factor, then calls an unnamed routine. The scan ends at a sentinel value.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16B66
name: spawn_entries_matching_cells_alt
description: Scans a list of offsets for cells whose flag bits match a mask. For each match it claims a free 16-byte entry, writing its position, a kind byte and two values from tables scaled by a factor, then calls an unnamed routine. The scan ends at a sentinel value.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16BF6
name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use; it performs no work.

name: spawn_positioned_entries
description: Repeatedly claims free 16-byte entries from a table of positions, writing position bytes, a kind byte, a state byte and a 16-bit value from a per-index table. It calls unnamed routines until a candidate position is out of range and returns a combined 32-bit value.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16C36
name: spawn_positioned_entries_alt
description: Repeatedly claims free 16-byte entries from a table of positions, writing position bytes, a kind byte, a state byte and a 16-bit value from a per-index table. It calls unnamed routines until a candidate position is out of range and returns a combined value.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16CC8
name: claim_entry_with_index_size
description: Claims the first free 16-byte entry, writing two position bytes and a kind byte, and sets a 16-bit size field from a per-index table, returning one. It returns zero when no entry is free.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16CEA
name: initialize_struct_from_registers
description: Writes a kind byte and two position bytes from registers into a given entry, sets a 16-bit size field from a per-index table, writes a state byte, and returns one.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16D2C
name: process_cell_area_around_entry
description: Walks a rectangular area of table cells around a position, calling unnamed routines for each cell with flag bits set. It then adds a fixed offset to cells whose low nibble is nonzero, advances a table offset, and returns the last combined value, or completes the entry's state update when the area is exhausted.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16DD6
name: process_cell_area_with_params
description: Walks a rectangular area of table cells defined by its parameters, calling unnamed routines for flagged cells and adjusting cell values by a fixed offset. It advances the table offset, or completes the state update when the list is exhausted.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16DF0
name: process_cell_area_list
description: Iterates a list of entries, adjusting table cells in each covered rectangle by a fixed offset when their low nibble is nonzero, and calling unnamed routines for flagged entries. It returns the combined result.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16E66
name: advance_counter_by_four
description: Adds four to the 16-bit counter field at offset twenty of the structure and returns.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16E6E
name: apply_table_cell_updates
description: Calls an unnamed routine a fixed number of times, then walks a table of three-byte records. It copies a value into each matching table cell whose low nibble equals a recorded value, then calls unnamed routines a count derived from another routine's result.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16EDE
name: modulo_decrement_loop
description: Calls an unnamed routine and takes its result modulo a global value to set a loop count. It then calls two other routines once per count, counting down to minus one.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:16F20
name: claim_cell_entry_if_unlinked
description: Checks a cell's entry list for an existing entry kind. When none exists and the cell's low nibble is nonzero, it claims a free 16-byte entry with position and table-derived values and calls unnamed routines, returning zero. It returns one when a matching entry already exists and minus one when the table value is zero.
